# ために・ように・のに・Vstem＋に — the purpose family

**[ために (purpose)](<../grammar/tame-ni.md#purpose> "In order to achieve a goal; marks deliberate purpose")**
:   Deliberate purpose — a goal you act to achieve, same subject: 家を買うために貯金している。Volitional; for 'so that X can happen', use ように.

**[ように (so that)](<../grammar/you-ni.md#so-that> "So that X can happen; marks an intended result or capability")**
:   An aimed-at result you don't directly control — potentials and negatives: 聞こえるように大きな声で話した。Non-volitional; contrast ために.

**[のに (purpose 'for doing')](<../grammar/noni.md#purpose-for-doing> "For doing something; nominalizes an action as a purpose or use. The tell is the matrix predicate — use/need/cost words (便利・使う・かかる・必要) follow purpose のに.")**
:   Utility — 'for doing X': このナイフはパンを切るのに便利だ。The matrix predicate is the tell — 便利・使う・かかる・必要 mark purpose; anything else, expect 'although'.

**[Vstem＋に (purpose)](<../grammar/vstem-ni.md#purpose> "In order to do; Vstem＋に pairs with a motion verb such as 行く, 来る or 帰る, and marks the movement's purpose")**
:   Purpose of MOVEMENT — verb stem + に + 行く/来る/帰る: 映画を見に行く。Only with motion verbs; elsewhere reach for ために or ように.

**[のために (noun purpose)](<../grammar/no-tame-ni.md#noun-purpose> "For a noun's purpose or benefit; marks what preparation serves")**
:   Purpose or benefit anchored to a NOUN: 家族のために働く・試験のために勉強する。The noun version of ために; verb clauses drop the の.
